Each vertex link has f=(10,30,24); separately replayed its staged 30-pair matching leaving one vertex and three 2-cells and checked link mod-2 ranks (9,21). The source verifier checks acyclicity of the complete Hasse matching; no critical 1-cells give wedge^3 S2 for each link. Cyclic translations act transitively. Hence non-manifold despite S1×S2 homology.
